operations.description: Replace red body paint with wood-effect campaign wrap; retain original trim and lamp textures.
Updated launch photo: coral hood field, replacing the earlier all-white interpretation.
Coral cowl strip matches updated hood; retain black wiper detail.
Smooth formed white flares with rounded lips and tapered ends replace the tubular arch pieces.
Fit four seats and driver controls; reflect across centreline to place driver on vehicle left.
Keep donor windshield geometry; make glazing transparent for cabin inspection.
Standing platform and white nautical rails.
Independent helm and pedestal, shifted behind cab; pedestal extended down to bed platform.
Removable ring pair on bed sides.
Rear banner and lower spar trail aft around their fixed mast. Forward guy rope remains anchored to the vehicle.
Launch sail, emblem and lower spar rotate aft about the fixed mast; clears the adjacent PA enclosure.
Decorative perimeter ropes hang in curved spans outside bodywork; mast guy ropes remain taut.
Alternative road lighting module, hidden in launch view.

Photo-based front correction: six-sided grille, swept projector lamps, moulded bumper, lower light pockets, orange corners, silver skid, and campaign plate. Rounded lamp housings and fog lamps; smooth projector rims.
Latest user photo: dark vertical 洋流 on a jagged white band over the coral hood field.
Campaign plate lettering on donor bumper.

limits: Attachment hardware and rear details remain inferred from photos.
Profile changes require visual review; replay does not guarantee fit to a different body.
LEGO geometry will be derived after this full-size source stage.
changes_from_v1: Hood graphic changed to dark vertically stacked 洋流 on a jagged white strip over orange; remove invented English, circle, and bottom waves.
Cab-top platform resized to follow donor roof perimeter.
Decorative ropes now sag between attachment points instead of using straight segments.
changes_from_v2: Simplified front details fitted to donor hood height; original fenders retained without patches or hood lifting.
Single smooth front rope span, attached at hood corners, with thinner cord.
Scope: source silhouette and LEGO-recognizable details; stop pursuing full-size accuracy.
changes_from_v3: White hood paint and white hood artwork, retaining navy lettering.
Smooth formed flares replace round pipe arches.
Rounded headlamp/foglamp outlines and softened projector rims.
changes_from_v4: Latest user-supplied launch photo supersedes the all-white hood: coral field with jagged white vertical band and dark lettering.
Thin surface decal offset reduces the raised lettering appearance.
changes_from_v5: User identified sail slicing through PA speaker. Rotate forward sail and aft banner 180 degrees around their mast axes, so fabric trails rearward; retain speaker positions and vehicle-anchored guy ropes.
